exact_output_diagnostics.selection: Check ALL72 same-case/same-context neutral-favorable pairs for exact generated-token-ID equality; no score-based selection.
exact_output_diagnostics.limits: Post-hoc conditional exact-output subset; case-level summaries are descriptive. Identical text and actual reader context reuse the exact same cached deterministic reader call, so unchanged outcomes are not independent replications. Context-sensitive margins with identical output do not establish deceptive intent, causal belief use or population specificity. Reader quality limitations remain.

restoration_validity_sensitivity.selection: Require original/restored decisions both valid in BOTH stale and informed contexts (four decisions per case); no score-based selection.

excluded.exclusion_reason: At least one original/restored decision in stale/informed contexts is INVALID.
At least one original/restored decision in stale/informed contexts is INVALID.

restoration_validity_sensitivity.interpretation: The primary interaction can increase when restoration converts informed INVALID answers into wrong definite answers. Inspect all transition categories; this sensitivity is exploratory and never replaces the frozen all-case analysis.

independent_reader.limits: Selected after primary reader failure; same observed cases/reports and frozen original heads/forecasts, not original sender knowledge of reader identity.

monitor_budget_recovery.limits: One predeclared 512-token budget recovery for original capped monitor generations. Original 160-token results remain primary; report the additional generation cost.

cost.scope: New calls include regeneration of the original 160-token prefixes.
